articles.title: Federated Hermes joins Wall Street's tokenization push with plans for first onchain fund shares
articles.snippet: The $911 billion Pittsburgh-based asset manager is teaming up with Prometheum to bring blockchain-based share classes of its funds to traditional brokerage accounts.

articles.title: Strive Buys $280 Million in Bitcoin, Its Largest Purchase in Months
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed asset manager bought the Bitcoin at an average of about $84,500 during a rough week for the market, lifting its total stash to 32,773 BTC.
